#### Quick Guide: Matching Your Sleep Style to a Mattress

- **Back Sleepers:** Look for a **medium-firm** (5.5 to 7 out of 10) mattress. You need enough contouring to support the natural curve of your lower back without your hips dropping too deep.[[1]](https://news.hss.edu/6-best-mattresses-for-back-pain-according-to-textile-and-medical-experts/)
- **Side Sleepers:** Look for a **medium to medium-soft** (4 to 6 out of 10) hybrid with good pressure relief around the shoulders and hips so your spine doesn't hitch upward.
- **Stomach Sleepers:** Look for a **firm** mattress (7+ out of 10). Stomach sleeping forces your lower back to arch; a soft bed makes it worse. *(Tip: Moving to your back or side is usually better for back pain if you can manage it).* [[1]](https://news.hss.edu/6-best-mattresses-for-back-pain-according-to-textile-and-medical-experts/)
